tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: Lists the component packages assigned to a project, each with its name, version, and description, and marks which one is active. Read-only. Use it to decide which npm package to import from, or to read the installed version before calling get_component_updates. It lists packages, not their contents

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_packages" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Lists the component packages assigned to a project, each with its name, version, and description, and marks which one is active. Read-only. Use it to decide whi…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
